articles.title: US Justice Dept sues to block possible Alaska election of Democrat to Senate
articles.content: Critics, including ​both Democratic and some Republican election officials, view the moves as federal overreach. Control of the US Senate could come down to Alaska, where incumbent Republican Senator Dan S. Sullivan is running a closely contested race against Democrat Mary Peltola.
